brief.ask: Art-direct "Aurora Covenant Sky" — #13 of the 72 Ambo church visualizers (Calm Contemporary Worship lyric visualizer, Collection I of 72; subgenre Scenic Nature). Premise: Emerald and sapphire magnetic auroral curtains over alpine lake & spruce pines. Tall northern evergreens and a mirror-still alpine lake reflect sweeping magnetic curtains of emerald, teal, and violet-gold aurora borealis. Lighting today: Key: Celestial auroral curtains in emerald/teal over dark forest horizon. Service use: Majesty of creation, Christmas/Epiphany, awe & wonder songs. Audio mapping today: Harmonic → Ripples vertical auroral light curtains across the sky; Vocal → Adds violet-gold corona to the aurora top edge; Swell → Brightens the emerald aurora reflection in the alpine lake. Palette: #050C14 #0F2E3D #2CE0A3 #D4F7EC. Keep the id, name, premise and palette; rebuild the direction: the geometry and depth planes, typography for the worship lyric band (one line at a time, four to five seconds a line, word-by-word progression), image logic (how the procedural scene (no concept plate: the plate is generative, in code) and the procedural scene meet), texture, motion, and which audio channel drives what. Decide it — the lead's lens will drive the kit's material weave and optical pass for this one.
brief.audience: Congregations watching a projector or LED wall from the pews, five to forty metres away, eyes on the words; and the worship leader or volunteer running Ambo live from a laptop.
brief.feeling: Stillness and reverence — a sanctuary that breathes with the singer's voice; gorgeous, slow, never a screensaver.
constraints: Build method (fixed): a real-time Canvas 2D audio-reactive renderer in Plajah's worship visualizer kit — sanctuary background, multi-plane depth (god rays, motes, bokeh), the kit's Council optical pass (35mm light leaks, anamorphic flare, film grain, colour punch, and a tactile material weave keyed to the LEAD director's lens) and the kit's lyric / scripture typography engine. No video playback, no WebGL, no assets beyond the one concept plate.

Audio drives amplitude, colour, light, growth and glow only — never the position of the words. Envelopes are smoothed; nothing strobes or flashes (photosensitive-safe); uptempo pulses are spring-damped.

The reading band is sacred: lyrics or scripture must stay legible at 1920×1080 and 4K from the back pew, over the busiest moment of the scene. A text-safe dimming band is part of the kit; direct how the scene yields to it.

Typefaces are fixed to the kit's open-licensed set: Noto Serif (text serif), Outfit / Inter (sans), Cinzel (display), JetBrains Mono. Direct scale, case, tracking, measure and hierarchy, not new families.

Sacred imagery is used correctly and respectfully: biblical places and objects are specific and attributable, never costume; nothing denominational or branded; nothing that reads as a music video or a screensaver.
Runs at 60 fps on an integrated-GPU laptop driving a projector: favour layered gradients, cached textures and a few large shapes over particle storms.
Keep this visualizer's id, name, premise and four-colour palette. The council owns the direction, not the catalogue entry.
references: No concept plate: the scene is built entirely in code from the premise.
Sample lyric lines on the band: "Be still my soul the Lord is on thy side" / "Bear patiently the cross of grief or pain".

proposals.title: Cantus Firmus in Emerald Light
proposals.idea: The aurora is not atmosphere but structural voice — a mathematically governed counterpoint of vertical curtains, horizontal lake reflection, and word progression that obeys a single tonal law before any audio event occurs.
proposals.geometry: A φ-derived vertical grid divides the 16:9 canvas into three primary zones: sky (upper 61.8%), reflection lake (lower 23.6%), and a treeline horizon band (15% at the golden cut). Within the sky zone, seven auroral curtain columns are spaced at φ-intervals from the canvas centerline — not symmetrically, but harmonically, so the eye finds rest at the dominant column left-of-center. Each curtain is a sinusoidal ribbon whose amplitude envelope is a stored waveform, not a live random — it repeats with drift, like a cantus firmus with ornamentation. The lake reflection is a vertical inversion of the sky geometry, sampled at 24×14 luminance grid points (matching the concept-plate discipline already established for this collection), each grid node seeding a bokeh mote whose radius is proportional to its inherited sky luminance. The treeline is a row of procedural spruce silhouettes: seven trees,
proposals.typography: Cinzel, Regular weight, for the active lyric line: 52px at 1080p (scales to 104px at 4K), set in tracked small-caps at +120 letter-spacing, centered, all-caps. Colour: #D4F7EC at base, luminance-lifted toward white on vocal swell — never below 4.5:1 contrast against the dimming band. Word-by-word progression: each word fades in at 180ms opacity ramp, previous words drop to 65% opacity and shift 1px up — a micro-recession that marks temporal hierarchy without movement that disturbs. The completed line holds for the remainder of its four-to-five-second window, then dissolves in 320ms. No slide, no wipe, no kinetic entrance — the word arrives as a note enters a chord. A secondary scripture or song-title line in Noto Serif Italic, 22px, #2CE0A3, sits 28px below the lyric baseline, tracking +60, visible only between lyric lines at 40% opacity — it is the pedal tone under the melody. No Outfit
proposals.imageLogic: There is no concept plate and no imported asset. The scene is entirely procedural Canvas 2D: seven sinusoidal curtain ribbons drawn as fillRect columns with per-pixel gradient fills computed from the palette constants (#050C14 base, #0F2E3D mid-sky, #2CE0A3 curtain body, #D4F7EC corona tip); the lake is a ctx.scale(1,-1) mirror of the sky draw pass, composited at globalAlpha 0.55 with a horizontal blur pass (3-sample box, CPU-safe) to simulate surface tension; spruce silhouettes are cached once as seven OffscreenCanvas paths on init and composited as a single layer. God rays are six radial gradient stripes originating from a point 8% left of canvas center at the horizon, drawn before the curtain layer, at globalAlpha 0.12 — structural, not decorative. Bokeh motes: maximum 48 circles, radius 3–14px, positions seeded from the 24×14 luminance grid on init, animated with per-mote phase offse
proposals.texture: Linen-grain optical surface: the noise texture is generated once at init (Math.random per pixel, seeded to a fixed value so the grain is stable across frames and does not strobe), horizontally stretched 1.4× to suggest woven tooth rather than film grain. This is the material weave mandated by the classical lens — light must have a substrate to rest on. The aurora curtains carry a vertical micro-texture: each column's gradient has seven luminance stops, not a smooth ramp, creating a banded structure that reads as atmospheric strata at distance. The lake reflection adds a second texture register: the 3-sample horizontal blur is applied only in the lower 23.6% zone, so the water surface has a distinctly different material quality from the sky — smoother, heavier, earned by physics. No particle storm; no confetti; no shimmer that cannot be explained by the scene's physical premise.
proposals.motion: Everything moves in governed intervals. At scene open: sky gradient fades in over 1.8s (the primary measure); curtain columns emerge column by column in φ-time intervals (0.6s, 1.0s, 1.6s, 2.6s — a Fibonacci sequence in seconds, truncated at four beats to avoid fatigue), left dominant column first; treeline silhouettes composite in at 2.2s as a single layer; lake reflection fades in at 2.6s; bokeh motes begin their drift at 3.0s. Steady-state motion: curtain ribbons oscillate at 0.04Hz base frequency, each column phase-offset by π/7 from its neighbour — the aurora breathes as a polyphonic structure, not a single wave. Audio mapping: Harmonic amplitude drives curtain column width (±8% of base width, spring-damped τ=0.3s) and ripple frequency (0.04Hz + harmonic × 0.02Hz); Vocal amplitude adds violet-gold (#D4B8FF blended toward #D4F7EC) to the corona tip gradient stop of all columns simult
proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D real-time renderer. Init pass: generate and cache the 256×256 linen-noise OffscreenCanvas; compute and cache seven spruce silhouette OffscreenCanvas paths using the φ-height sequence; compute and store the 24×14 luminance grid node positions and their assigned bokeh radii. Per-frame draw order: (1) sky background gradient; (2) god-ray stripes; (3) aurora curtain columns with per-column sinusoidal offset and audio-driven width; (4) treeline composite; (5) lake reflection (mirrored sky pass + horizontal blur); (6) bokeh motes at current drift positions; (7) optical pass — linen grain tile, anamorphic flare strokes, colour punch multiply; (8) text-safe dimming band; (9) lyric and scripture typography. proposals.humanTrace: The editorial act that is legible in every frame: the decision to make the dominant aurora curtain not centred but left-of-centre at the φ-position, so the eye finds a specific place to rest — a choice a rule-following algorithm would not make, because the rule says 'centre' and the judgment says 'no, here.' The linen grain stretched horizontally is a second trace: it records the decision that this light sits on a woven surface, not a screen. The Fibonacci curtain emergence sequence is a third: it is not random, not linear, not logarithmic — it is a specific cultural memory of how a polyphonic voice enters a texture, one line at a time, each waiting for the previous to establish itself.
proposals.risk: The risk is that the governed intervals and φ-proportions produce a scene that reads as calculated rather than felt — that the congregation sees the geometry before they see the light. This risk is worth carrying because the alternative — aurora curtains that drift without structural law — produces a screensaver, exactly what the brief forbids. A scene with a cantus firmus beneath it can be read the same way twice; it accumulates meaning across a service rather than losing it. The resolution is in the scale of the shapes: at forty metres, no one sees the φ-grid; they see the aurora breathe in a way that feels inevitable.

proposals.title: Ink Curtain Over Still Water
proposals.idea: The aurora is not a backdrop — it is a registration event: every curtain band is a declared shader constant before the first lyric word exists, so the scene is already committed when the congregation walks in.
proposals.geometry: Two hard horizontal registers split the canvas at the golden ratio cut (0.618 from top): sky above, lake mirror below — no soft blend between them, a single-pixel horizon rule in #0F2E3D that functions like a press crop mark. Sky zone: five vertical aurora curtain bands, widths set as Fibonacci ratios (1:1:2:3:2) of canvas width, positions locked as constants CURTAIN_OFFSETS[] before any audio envelope touches them — the curtains do not drift, they breathe in place. Spruce silhouettes: a procedural spine-and-branch algorithm, trunk positions seeded from a fixed integer array TREE_SEEDS[], never random at runtime, so the forest is the same shape every service. Lake mirror: the sky is reflected with a y-axis flip and a vertical sine-displacement field RIPPLE_PHASE keyed to harmonic amplitude — the geometry of the reflection is the geometry of the sky, not a separate painterly pass. Lyric b
proposals.typography: Noto Serif, weight 300, tracked at +0.08em, sentence case — not shouting, not whispering. Single lyric line centered on the horizontal axis of the lyric band. Scale: 4.2vw at 1080p (≈45px), which reads from 40 metres without crowding the aurora. Word-by-word reveal: each word fades in at 180ms opacity ramp, previous words hold full opacity — no slide, no bounce, just ink appearing on the sheet. The active word carries a 1px underline in #2CE0A3 at 60% opacity that dissolves when the next word arrives. Line transition: outgoing line drops to 0 opacity over 400ms, incoming line arrives from 0 — no vertical movement, the band stays anchored. Text-safe band: a full-width gradient rectangle, #050C14 at 0.72 opacity, height = 2.8× the cap-height of the type, sits under the lyric zone always — it does not animate, it does not pulse, it is a permanent physical fact like the backing sheet on a si
proposals.imageLogic: No concept plate. The scene is entirely procedural: (1) Sky gradient: two-stop radial from #0F2E3D (centre-top) to #050C14 (edges), drawn once and cached as an offscreen canvas — never redrawn per frame, only composited. (2) Aurora curtains: five vertical sinusoidal strip-gradients, each strip a linear gradient from transparent → #2CE0A3 → #D4F7EC → transparent along its width, drawn with globalAlpha keyed to harmonic envelope. Curtain height oscillates ±8% of canvas height at 0.15 Hz per curtain (each curtain has its own phase offset declared as CURTAIN_PHASE[] constant). Vocal envelope adds a violet-gold corona: a second gradient pass at the top 18% of each curtain, colour interpolating from #2CE0A3 toward a warm #D4B483 proxy, opacity = vocal_amp × 0.6. (3) Spruce silhouettes: drawn once to an offscreen canvas using TREE_SEEDS[], composited as a single layer — not redrawn each frame.
proposals.texture: Film grain: a 256×256 noise tile, generated once at init from a seeded PRNG (GRAIN_SEED = 1347), tiled across the canvas at globalAlpha 0.04 — it is the same grain every frame, not re-seeded, so it reads as material surface not as flicker. This is the human trace the Minimalist will try to strip: I leave it in because it is what separates a sanctuary wall from a monitor. Anamorphic flare: a single horizontal lens streak at the horizon rule, 4px tall, colour #D4F7EC at 0.18 opacity, width = 0.7 canvas width, blurred with a cached 1D Gaussian kernel — it fires only when swell_amp > 0.6, fades in over 800ms, fades out over 1200ms. 35mm light leak: a top-left corner radial gradient, #2CE0A3 at 0.06 opacity, fixed position — not audio-reactive, always present, always the same, like a press registration stain that survived the run.
proposals.motion: Order of operations each frame: (1) Composite cached sky gradient. (2) Draw aurora curtains — harmonic envelope scales globalAlpha 0.4→0.85; curtain heights breathe at their declared phases. (3) If vocal_amp > 0.2, draw violet-gold corona pass at curtain tops. (4) Composite cached spruce silhouette layer. (5) Draw horizon rule (1px, always). (6) Composite flipped sky as lake mirror; apply precomputed ripple offset rows keyed to harmonic_amp × swell_amp. (7) If swell_amp > 0.6, draw anamorphic flare at horizon. (8) Composite film grain tile. (9) Draw text-safe band. (10) Draw lyric word-by-word. Spring damping on all envelopes: attack τ = 0.12s, release τ = 0.8s — nothing strobes. The slowest thing in the frame is the light leak (never changes). The fastest thing is the word underline (180ms). Everything else lives between 0.8s and 6s. The scene breathes; it does not perform.
proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D renderer, 60fps, integrated-GPU safe. All aurora geometry is drawn with Path2D and createLinearGradient — no WebGL, no shader programs. Offscreen canvases for sky, spruce silhouettes, and grain tile, created at init and cached for the session. Ripple lookup table: Float32Array(64) precomputed at init, indexed by (frame_count + row_index) mod 64, values = sin(i × π/32) — no per-pixel sine calls at runtime. All declared constants (CURTAIN_OFFSETS, CURTAIN_PHASE, TREE_SEEDS, GRAIN_SEED, HORIZON_Y = canvas.height × 0.618) written to a config object at top of file — they are the registration marks, the prior physical commitment. Audio envelopes: Web Audio API AnalyserNode, FFT size 256, harmonic band 200–800Hz, vocal band 800–3000Hz, swell band = overall RMS, all smoothed with exponential moving average α = 0.15.
proposals.humanTrace: The declared integer arrays CURTAIN_OFFSETS[], CURTAIN_PHASE[], and TREE_SEEDS[] are the human trace — they are editorial decisions made before the first render, committed in code before any audio signal exists. They function exactly like registration marks on a press: the scene is already shaped by a prior human act. The grain tile seeded at GRAIN_SEED = 1347 is a second trace: that specific noise pattern, that specific seed, is a choice that survived into the material. These are not decorative. They are the evidence that a person was here before the congregation.
proposals.risk: The risk is that this scene looks too spare for a Majesty-of-Creation Christmas context — no particle storm, no sweeping camera move, no shimmer cascade. Baroque will say it is not glorious enough. I say: a curtain of aurora that breathes with the singer's voice and stays in the same position every week becomes a sanctuary, not a screensaver. The risk is worth it because the alternative — a generative aurora that wanders and blooms and never commits to a position — is a mood video, not a space for worship. This one is accountable to its own declared geometry. That accountability is what makes it feel like a place.

arguesWith.why: Baroque will want the aurora to sweep, bloom, and cascade — volume and glory for a Majesty-of-Creation brief. I expect a push for particle density, layered glow halos, and a corona that floods the top third on every swell. proposals.title: One Curtain, One Reflection
proposals.idea: A single vertical aurora curtain and its lake reflection are the only geometry; every audio event is a breath into that one structure, never an addition to it.
proposals.geometry: Three horizontal depth planes coded as pure gradient bands, not placed objects: (1) void sky — #050C14 occupying the upper 58% of the frame; (2) a horizon seam at 58% — a 4px hairline of #2CE0A3 at 2% opacity, the only hard edge in the scene; (3) lake mirror — the lower 42%, a vertical flip of the sky band with a luminance offset of −18%. One aurora curtain: a single sinusoidal ribbon, amplitude 14% of frame height, period 110% of frame width, generated from a φ-based Bézier spine recalculated each frame from two slowly drifting control points (Δx ≤ 0.04 px/frame, Δy ≤ 0.02 px/frame). The curtain occupies x: 12%–88%, y: 8%–54%. Its reflection is the curtain path mirrored across the 58% seam, luminance reduced by 22%, with a horizontal Perlin ripple offset (scale 0.003, magnitude 3px) that is the only disturbance in the lake plane. proposals.typography: Noto Serif, weight 300, italic. Single lyric line centred at y 76% — inside the lake plane, never in the sky. Scale: 2.8vw at 1080p, 2.6vw at 4K (cap-height ≈ 38px at 1080p). Case: sentence-case only; no all-caps, no small-caps — the words are spoken, not announced. Tracking: 0.04em. Leading: irrelevant — one line at a time. Word-by-word reveal: each word fades in over 180ms at opacity 0 → 1, no slide, no blur — pure luminance entrance, 4–5 seconds per complete line. Active word: #D4F7EC at 96% opacity. Preceding words: step down to 72% opacity over 600ms after their successor appears — the line dims back as it completes, leaving the current word brightest. The text-safe band is a vertical gradient strip from y 68% to y 88%: #050C14 at 0% opacity at its edges, 55% opacity at y 78% — wide enough that the Noto Serif sits in guaranteed contrast regardless of aurora state. proposals.imageLogic: No concept plate. The scene is entirely procedural Canvas 2D. The aurora curtain is drawn each frame as a filled quadratic Bézier strip: upper spine path + lower spine path offset by curtain-width(t), filled with a linear gradient along the strip's local normal — stops: #2CE0A3 at 0%, #0F2E3D at 38%, #2CE0A3 at 62%, #050C14 at 100%. Harmonic amplitude modulates curtain-width between 3.2% and 7.8% of frame height. Vocal amplitude injects a violet-gold additive pass (#C8A0E8 → #D4B860) as a second gradient overlay on the curtain's upper 30%, opacity 0 → 0.38, smoothed with an 80ms attack / 400ms release envelope. Swell amplitude brightens the lake reflection's luminance offset from −22% toward −6%, and widens the Perlin ripple magnitude from 3px to 9px — the lake wakes slightly, then returns. The forest horizon ellipse is static; it does not respond to audio. The sky void is static. Three
proposals.texture: The kit's optical pass is directed as follows for this scene: Film grain — reduced to 0.6× kit default (σ=3.2px luminance noise), applied only above y 58% (sky plane); the lake plane receives no grain — it must read as still water, not paper. Anamorphic flare — one horizontal streak anchored to the curtain's peak luminance point, width 88% of frame, height 0.4% of frame, #D4F7EC at 4% opacity, non-animated. 35mm light leak — suppressed entirely; a light leak at the frame edge would break the horizon seam's function as the scene's only hard edge. Colour punch — applied as a single LUT-equivalent pass: lift #050C14 blacks by +2 luminance units to prevent crush on dim projectors; pull #2CE0A3 green channel +4 to hold the emerald against lamp variance. Material weave keyed to this lens: none. The Radical Minimalist's material weave is the absence of weave — the canvas surface is the material
proposals.motion: Four motion registers, all spring-damped (stiffness 0.07, damping 0.72): (1) Curtain spine drift — two φ-grid control points move on independent Lissajous paths at 0.003 Hz and 0.0047 Hz; this is the scene's resting breath, unlinked to audio. (2) Curtain width — Harmonic amplitude envelope (40ms attack, 1.2s release) widens the ribbon; maximum excursion 7.8% frame height; returns to 3.2% at silence. (3) Corona overlay — Vocal amplitude envelope (80ms attack, 400ms release) raises violet-gold opacity on curtain upper edge; maximum 0.38. (4) Lake luminance and ripple — Swell amplitude envelope (200ms attack, 2.4s release) brightens reflection and widens Perlin ripple offset; maximum ripple magnitude 9px. Nothing strobes. proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D renderer, 60fps target. Frame budget allocation: sky gradient fill (1 draw call), aurora curtain strip (1 quadratic Bézier fill + 1 gradient overlay), lake reflection (1 quadratic Bézier fill + Perlin offset lookup from a 128-sample pre-baked Float32Array, refreshed every 4 frames), forest ellipse (1 radial gradient fill, cached, redrawn only on resize), text-safe band (1 linear gradient fill), lyric text (ctx.fillText per word, opacity interpolated). Optical pass composited as a single canvas layer above scene: grain texture pre-generated as an offscreen 1920×1080 canvas at init, scrolled by (Math.random()*2−1, Math.random()*2−1) each frame for motion. Anamorphic streak pre-rendered as a 1920×8px offscreen gradient, composited at globalAlpha 0.04. Total draw calls per frame: ≤ 14. Perlin noise: a single-octave implementation using a 256-entry permutation table baked at init —
proposals.humanTrace: Editorial selection: the decision to use one curtain, one reflection, and one horizon seam — and to suppress every other candidate element (particle motes, god-ray shafts, bokeh layers, spruce silhouettes as placed objects) — is the human act. The scene's restraint is not default; it is a sequence of refusals, each one a mark. The Lissajous drift constants (0.003 Hz, 0.0047 Hz) were chosen because their ratio is irrational relative to the lyric line duration of 4–5 seconds, ensuring the curtain never repeats a posture during a single lyric — that non-coincidence is a compositional decision, not a procedural default.
proposals.risk: The risk is that congregations or operators read the scene as unfinished — that the emptiness registers as failure rather than as structure. This is worth it because the alternative (adding spruce silhouettes, bokeh motes, god rays, a second aurora ribbon) would make the scene compete with the lyric rather than hold it. The one curtain and its reflection are already the maximum: every addition would cost focus without buying meaning. If the emptiness fails, it fails honestly — and that failure is diagnostic, not decorative.
